description: The account's call records, newest first: request_id, capability, status code, latency, rows returned, whether it was charged, and the amount. Pass request_id (the request_id / X-Request-Id of any call) to look up one call, including its charge's final state (charged, refunded or partly refunded) and any async job it started. failed_only=true lists failures only. Needs the account read permission "requests:read" on this key: keys not limited to product lines have the three read permissions by default; for a key limited to product lines, the account owner turns it on in the console (API Keys → permissions). Free.

failed_only.description: List failed calls only, default false

request_id.description: Look up one call; the other params are ignored when given

name: everyinfra_requests
title: Calls and refunds
